# composer

Composes, records and serves what equin appends to an agent's system prompt —
see [`system-prompt`](../../CLAUDE.md). Split from the section contribution so
a plugin that contributes a section (a portable `server/` half such as
`page/annotations/agent-access`) does not carry the conversations table
(`tasks-core`, and through it attachments) into its closure.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Composes what equin appends to an agent's system prompt at a spawn: composeSystemPromptAppend (the preprompt, then every SystemPrompt.Section in id order inside <equin-context id>, a throwing section reported and replaced by a notice), which the launch and resume paths call right before the agent process starts. Records each part's size per conversation (conversations_ext_system_prompt), read by the context card through the lookup-only conversations.system-prompt collection. Apart from the section contribution so a contributor's closure does not carry the conversations table.
- Server:
  - Contributes: `resource.declare` "conversations.system-prompt:rows"
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/system-prompt.SystemPrompt`
    - `conversations/system-prompt.SystemPromptSection`
    - `infra/entity-extensions.defineExtension`
    - `network/live.serveCollection`
    - `tasks/tasks-core._conversations`
  - DB schema: `plugins/conversations/plugins/system-prompt/plugins/composer/server/internal/tables.ts`
  - Entity extension of: `tasks/tasks-core` (table `conversations_ext_system_prompt`)
  - Exports (values):
    - `_conversationSystemPromptTable`
    - `composeSystemPromptAppend`
  - Resources: `conversations.system-prompt:rows` (keyed, point)
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: `conversations`
